dispute.claim_text: He told me before we started that I'd pay the ERP directly to him. I gave him five dollars in cash at the gantry. Then the app bill has the same five dollars again. Second time this has happened to me with this platform. There is no human to talk to.

counterparty_statement.text: I said the fare doesn't include ERP, which is true. If she gave me cash that was her choice; the app billed ERP as normal. I didn't charge twice; the app did.
